desc:
Welcome to Midnight Tacos 🌮  
LIKE 👍 + FAVORITE ⭐ And join the group [HayHar Studios] for a FREE toy gun in‑game 🔫

You’re working the night shift at a lonely taco stand on the edge of town. Customers wander in at strange hours… but something about them feels wrong. Their behavior gets stranger. The night gets quieter. And then he appears — an escaped criminal, fat, wearing a red shirt, a mariachi hat, and a huge mustache, watching you from the shadows.

Will you survive the night while he’s on the loose?

There are 3 endings in this game — try to get them all
👏 This game is multiplayer and can be played by up to 4 players at once. Playing with friends is recommended for the best experience.

🛒 Check out the shop for fun items to troll your friends with Complete the game 2x for a FREE gamepass item 🎁

Similar to: Midnight Station, Midnight Cleaners, Midnight Diner, The Night Shift, Midnight Massacre, Horror, Scary, Story, Taco Terror, Midnight Food Fight, Creepy Cashier
